info.title: Kyro Control API
info.description: Versioned P1 control-plane API. Runtime calls are actor-scoped; provider credentials never appear in request or response schemas.

get.summary: Bounded-cardinality HTTP counters and latency histogram

200.description: Prometheus text exposition; labels are limited to a fixed HTTP method set and status class.

303.description: Redirect to the configured identity provider.
Redirect to the configured UI after setting session cookies.

get.description: Returns a safe job view. The creator may read their own reconciliation command with current budget or manage authority, without project read access; all other jobs require read authority. The store checks this exception atomically.

JobCursor.name: before
JobCursor.description: Opaque base64url job sort cursor; it grants no access.

EffectCursor.name: before
EffectCursor.description: Effect UUID sort cursor; it grants no access.

InitialEventCursor.name: after
InitialEventCursor.description: Initial browser subscription cursor <project-uuid>:<sequence>; must match Last-Event-ID if both are supplied.

Session.description: Opaque session information; CSRF token is returned only to the authenticated browser.

Organizations.description: Organizations and roles visible to this actor.

Memberships.description: Organization memberships visible to this actor.

ProjectSnapshot.description: Project snapshot with the strong current revision ETag.

CreatedProjectSnapshot.description: Created project snapshot with the initial revision ETag.

AppRevision.description: Immutable revision with its strong revision ETag.

ApplyChangesResult.description: Applied command and new immutable revision with its strong revision ETag.

Job.description: Safe actor-authorized job metadata; request bodies and reconciliation evidence are omitted.

Budget.description: Budget snapshot with strong configuration ETag.

Effects.description: Bounded effect page; model output is visible only to authorized readers.

Error.description: Stable generic error; response is never cacheable.
